+"""Directed residual-tangent transport with endpoint codeword separation."""
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+
+def mechanism_loss(source, target, codebook, mask, **parameters):
+    """Compute the proposal's masked directed residual/codebook objective."""
+    eps = float(parameters.get("eps", 1e-8))
+    margin = float(parameters.get("margin", 0.1))
+    min_separation = float(parameters.get("min_separation", 0.2))
+    separation_weight = float(parameters.get("separation_weight", 1.0))
+    weight = float(parameters.get("weight", 0.0001))
+
+    # Hard nearest-neighbour assignments select endpoints; gradients still flow
+    # through the selected codewords and both latent vectors.
+    source_idx = torch.cdist(source, codebook).argmin(dim=1)
+    target_idx = torch.cdist(target, codebook).argmin(dim=1)
+    c_i, c_j = codebook[source_idx], codebook[target_idx]
+    r_s, r_t = source - c_i, target - c_j
+    d = F.normalize(target - source, dim=-1, eps=eps)
+    n = F.normalize(r_s - r_t, dim=-1, eps=eps)
+    # Directed progress along source -> target; asymmetric under endpoint swap.
+    directed = F.softplus(margin - (d * (r_s - r_t)).sum(dim=-1))
+    separation = F.relu(min_separation - torch.linalg.vector_norm(c_i - c_j, dim=-1)).square()
+    per_pair = directed + separation_weight * separation
+    return weight * (per_pair * mask.to(dtype=per_pair.dtype, device=per_pair.device)).mean()
